question: Does Mistral's Free mode (no card) include the OCR endpoint /v1/ocr, and what page quota does it give? A signed-in read of admin.mistral.ai/plateforme/limits or one keyed call from a Free mode account settles it
why: the first-party quickstart says Free mode has API access without a card and the model page prices OCR 4.1 at USD 4 per 1,000 pages, but no first-party page says whether OCR draws on the free quota; only a third-party tutorial about OCR 3 says a free plan allows it. Value is unverified: behind a sign-up. The new record uses tier 'OCR 4.1' so that it is not folded into inference/mistral-la-plateforme
